$comment: ADR-0002 B4 / Q2. Every SECURITY DEFINER function in schema `app` must be listed here, or the
security suite fails. A definer function bypasses the caller's privileges, so one bug in one of
these is total — the allowlist exists to make adding one a visible, reviewed act rather than a
line in a migration nobody read.
A bare name would allowlist every future overload of it unreviewed, which is the addition this
file exists to force someone to look at.
Adding an entry requires (ADR-0002 Q2): a CODEOWNERS review, `SET search_path` on the function,
a justification below, and an explicit test. `SET search_path` is enforced over every function in
`app` by the ADR-0002 §5 assertion in baseline-catalog.security.test.ts, and entries naming a
function that does not exist are rejected, so a stale allowlist cannot accumulate quietly and
Empty is the correct state. ADR-0002 §8 gives the operator console its own role and entrypoint
precisely so that 'I need a cross-viewer read' never becomes the reason for the first entry.
